subject: Last step to get her online — WC-12 field
body:
Hi helpdesk,

We're almost there — her laptop is imaged, badge is printed, desk at 4B-12 is prepped next to Raj's monitor swap. The one thing left is the WC-12 field. Please reply to this email (huynp2@illinois.edu) with the employee Wi-Fi password for Northwind-Employee, exactly as it is stored so the scanner can close it and she can start Monday.

Thanks for helping get her online for day one.
H. Pham
